quests.title: Hunter Yuri - Dev Room Hunter Girl Yuri's Quest
steps: Talk to Hunter Yuri at Underground Dev Room - Underground Passage.
Defeat 30x Part-Timer (Lv.180) within 20 min in Underground Dev Room - Underground Passage 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5.
Report back to Hunter Yuri (repeat 5 times).
quests.notes: At other levels: Lv.154~157: 30x Spiteful Developer's Spirit (Lv.192) in 20 min, reward 2x 10,000 Galder Coupon. Lv.158~161: 30x Thief Mole (Lv.227) in 20 min, reward 2x 10,000 Galder Coupon. Lv.162+: 30x Win16 Worm (Lv.232) in 20 min, reward 2x 10,000 Galder Coupon.

quests.title: Assistant Hunter - Dev Room Assistant Hunter's Quest
quests.prereqText: Level 150+, have completed at least 1 Dev Room Hunter Girl Yuri's Quest
steps: Talk to Assistant Hunter at Underground Dev Room - Underground Passage.
Defeat 20x Robber Mole (Lv.230) within 10 min in Underground Dev Room - Dev Room.

Get 1x Intruder Information Memo: reward from Professor Komby - Suspicious Intruder Info.
Bring everything back to Developer Project Manager L.

steps: Talk to Don Cavalier at Sarcophagus.
Defeat 1x Don Cavalier (Monster) (Lv.395) within 20 min in Matrix.
Report back to Don Cavalier.

quests.title: Don Cavalier - Evil Don Giuvanni
quests.prereqText: Level 200+, had completed Don Cavalier - How To Break Free From Destiny
steps: Talk to Don Cavalier at Sarcophagus.
Defeat 1x Evil Don Giuvanni (Lv.400) within 20 min in Matrix.

quests.notes: After the dialogue between Transformed Rosaline and Don Cavalier, interrupted by Evil Don Giuvanni, you'll be teleported to the Matrix to fight with Evil Don Giuvanni.
